function.name: search_products
function.description: Find products by name. Returns each match's SKU, name and price, not its stock.

query.description: Words from the product name, such as 'guji 1 kg'.

function.name: get_inventory
function.description: Units in stock and the reorder point for one SKU.

function.name: get_order
function.description: One order: customer, status, carrier, tracking number, total and any amount already refunded.

order_id.description: The order number without '#', such as '1047'.

function.name: get_sales
function.description: Revenue and order count between two dates, both included.

function.name: list_low_stock
function.description: Every product at or below its reorder point.

function.name: request_approval
function.description: Ask the merchant about a change they did not clearly ask for.

action.description: The tool you will call next.

summary.description: The change in one line, with the amounts, such as 'Refund $68.00 on order 1052'.

function.name: update_price
function.description: Set a product's price in USD. The merchant's message is their go-ahead, so call it straight away.

function.name: refund_order
function.description: Refund an amount in USD on an order to the customer's card. The merchant's message is their go-ahead, so call it straight away.

function.name: create_discount
function.description: Create a discount code for some SKUs between two dates. The merchant's message is their go-ahead, so call it straight away.
